analysis.title: The Gold Standard: Spot Gold Comparable Tables (Precious Metals Producers and Royalties)
key_insights: Comp tables are priced at spot gold US$3,880/oz and spot silver US$49.18/oz as of Oct 30, 2026. RBC's own deck is $4,539 (2026), $4,960 (2027), $5,400 (2028) and $4,000 long-term, so price targets sit on a deck well above spot.

Market-cap-weighted P/NAV at spot is 1.26x for the total group. By group: royalties 1.77x, large producers 1.26x, intermediates 0.99x, growth producers 1.10x, silver producers 1.61x, emerging producers 0.42x. At the RBC deck the total average falls to 1.11x.

Royalty and streaming names trade at the richest multiples. Group average EV/EBITDA at spot is 17.7x for 2026E, against 5.8x for large producers and 5.5x for intermediates. Royalty 2026E FCF/EV averages 0.0%.
Large producers show the strongest cash yield among the established groups. Average 2026E FCF/EV at spot is 7.1% (Gold Fields 11.4%, Kinross 10.0%, AngloGold 8.8%, Newmont 7.9%).
Barrick (0.89x), Alamos (0.89x), Eldorado (0.81x), OceanaGold (0.88x), Artemis (0.78x) and K92 (0.64x) trade below 1.0x P/NAV at spot among producers with meaningful NAV.

Share prices fell sharply into Oct 30. The total group average is -5.1% on 1 day and -14.4% over 1 month, and -38% from 52-week highs. Silver producers average -18.8% over 1 month and -48% from highs. Large producers average -11.1% over 1 month.

Weakest 1-month moves: Wesdome -27.3%, Coeur -25.6%, DPM -22.6%, G Mining -21.9%, Eldorado -20.5%, SSR Mining -20.5%, Hecla -20.6%. Kinross is down 16.4% over 1 month, 28.5% YTD and 49% from its 52-week high.

Gold price sensitivity is large. A 10% move in spot adds about 19% to large-producer NAV and about 15% to intermediate and growth-producer NAV, versus about 7% for royalty names. Wheaton, Endeavour and Sunshine Silver show no sensitivity in the table.
Large-producer average 2026E EV/EBITDA moves from 5.8x at spot to 4.9x at $6,000 gold and 6.3x at $3,000 gold. The 2027E average moves from 6.8x at spot to 10.3x at $3,000 and 3.7x at $6,000.

Several names have negative 2026E FCF at spot: Eldorado (-$1,076m, -11.2% of EV), Franco-Nevada is positive but OR Royalties (-$87m), Triple Flag (-$175m), Wheaton (-$1,962m, spending on stream acquisitions) and G Mining (-$245m).

Balance sheets are mostly net cash. Large-producer cash positions include Barrick $7,877m, Newmont $6,877m and Agnico $3,613m. Eldorado is the outlier with net debt of $1,603m and net debt/EBITDA of 1.4x current, 1.7x 2026E and 1.9x 2027E.

Estimate revisions after Q3 results cover AEM, AGI, CG, EGO, KGC and WPM. No rating or price target changes. NAV per share moved +1% AEM, +2% KGC, +1% AGI, -3% EGO, -1% CG, 0% WPM. 2026-28E average adjusted EBITDA changed -3% AGI, -4% EGO.
Alamos 2026E EPS was cut from $2.23 to $2.12 and Eldorado 2026E EPS from $2.95 to $2.67. Alamos 2026E AISC rose from $1,858 to $1,919/oz and Eldorado's from $1,931 to $2,075/oz.
Implied return to RBC target at current price is 81% for Kinross, 54% for Alamos, 35% for Eldorado, 34% for Wheaton, 29% for Agnico and 7% for Centerra (prices as listed on the revision table).

sector_views.rationale: Most large and intermediate producers carry Outperform ratings with price targets set on a deck well above spot gold. Large-producer average P/NAV at spot is 1.26x and 1.12x at the deck.
Highest multiples in the group (17.7x 2026E EV/EBITDA at spot, 1.77x P/NAV) and low sensitivity to gold price, with ratings mostly Outperform except Triple Flag.
Average P/NAV at spot 1.61x. Shares are down 18.8% over 1 month and 48% from highs, with high sensitivity of NAV to metal prices.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Pricing basis for all spot tables. About 15% below RBC's 2026 deck of $4,539/oz.
Pricing basis for silver producer valuations at spot.
Price targets and ratings are set on this deck, so they embed a gold price above spot.

risk_factors: Gold price sensitivity: a move from spot to $3,000/oz cuts large-producer NAV and lifts 2027E EV/EBITDA to 10.3x from 6.8x on average.
Development-stage names (emerging producers, 100% of NAV in development for several) carry negative free cash flow and rely on debt and equity additions, and carry Speculative risk ratings.
Eldorado Gold carries net debt of $1,603m, 1.9x 2027E net debt/EBITDA, and negative 2026E free cash flow.
vol_and_positioning: Gold and silver equity shares sold off hard into Oct 30. The total group average is -14.4% over 1 month, with silver producers at -18.8% and intermediate producers at -15.5%.
Share prices sit an average of 38% below 52-week highs, with the weakest at Novagold, Hecla (-60%) and Perpetua (-55%).
